calls into the Arno library, made the first time k-core, Leiden, SCC or triangle counting asks for it, whether or not the library is installed

the IVG Schema record (`"schema"`), the fingerprint of the classes last compiled (`"fingerprint"`) and those of the functions and procedures setup created (`"routines"`), which let a re-run skip an unchanged class set and unchanged routines
entries.backup: yes; without it the engine refuses the namespace until setup runs again

entries.purpose: the rows and indexes of the DDL tables above: each table keeps them in globals named from a hash of its class (`^<hash>.1` the rows, the others its indexes), which the class storage names

the rows and indexes of `ledger_revisions` and `ledger_stats`, named by their classes' storage, written when the ledger is enabled; `^Graph.KG.LedgerStatsI` stays empty, as that table's one index is its row ID

setup writes its version (`"__version"`) and nothing else; every row written then keeps the adjacency index (`"out"`, `"in"`, `"label"`) and each source's generation (`"gen"`), degree reads cache degrees (`"degc"`, and the whole-graph stamp `"degw"` when setup or `sync()` warms them), and the temporal index (`"tout"`, `"tin"`, `"bucket"`, `"tagg"`, `"tlast"`, `"edgeprop"`) has no SQL copy
entries.backup: yes: the temporal part exists nowhere else

entries.purpose: the integer-keyed copy of `^KG` the graph algorithms and BFS read, built by `engine.sync()`, and once by setup: the first setup run that finds rows in `rdf_edges` builds `^KG` and `^NKG` from them (and marks it in `^Graph.KG.Meta`)
entries.backup: no: `engine.sync()` rebuilds it (minutes on a large graph)
